picks.title: Meta's Muse accounts for 72% of AI agent requests, HUMAN finds
picks.excerpt: HUMAN Security says Meta's Muse drives 72% of AI-agent web requests, 84% aimed at product/search pages and 25% likelier to reach checkout - a measurement problem for advertisers and retailers.
picks.rationale: Hard numbers on AI shopping-agent traffic reaching product pages and checkout; it changes how marketers read their site analytics and attribution.

picks.title: As agencies push agentic media future, execs work to ward off client rogue fears
picks.excerpt: Dentsu/Carat's NBCU-Freewheel-Newton buying agent, Tinuiti's Bliss Point MCP server and Stagwell's Machine OS push agentic media buying while agencies manage client fears of rogue agents.
picks.rationale: Names the concrete agentic buying products agencies are deploying (Carat agent, Tinuiti MCP server, Stagwell Machine OS) and the guardrails clients demand.

picks.title: Google optimises its own revenue. Advertisers have to optimise theirs
picks.excerpt: Analysis of AI Max for Search auto-upgrades, Smart Bidding target behavior and 383M-impression match-type data: Google's AI claims fell from 14% to 7% more conversions.
picks.rationale: Data-backed look at AI Max and Smart Bidding (383M impressions; Google's own uplift claim halved from 14% to 7%), with direct implications for search bidding setups.

picks.title: AI In Regulated Paid Media: The Default Settings That Put Compliance At Risk
picks.excerpt: Google and Meta AI defaults that auto-alter approved creative or expand audiences can break compliance in regulated ad categories; what to audit.
picks.rationale: Actionable audit list for the Google and Meta AI defaults that rewrite approved creative or widen audiences, a compliance risk in regulated ad categories.

picks.title: Why ChatGPT ads won't likely impact holiday sales in a major way this year
picks.excerpt: Brands are testing ChatGPT ads, but high CPCs and unproven sales keep AI-assistant ads a small experimental slice of holiday budgets.
picks.rationale: Brand-side view of how much holiday budget is actually going to ChatGPT ads (high CPCs, small test slices), a counterweight to OpenAI's own pitch.
